svg.title: A working script in three voices
svg.desc: THE ARCHITECT. My trade is making systems talk to each other. Enterprise Integration Patterns with Apache Camel on Quarkus, Kafka with Debezium and Streams, cloud-native designs on AWS, Azure and GCP. (Ten years of fintech and insurtech. DDD, event-driven, observable from day one, load- and chaos-tested before shipping.) THE BUILDER. AI is in every step of how I work: spec, design, code, review, release. Lately I build the AI side too: agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills, agents, and the governance that lets a company trust them. (Spring AI, LangChain4j, Claude Code and Junie on the desk.) THE LEADER. I have led more than 200 people over the last five years and I coach developers into senior and architect roles. These days I also run corporate AI trainings, so a whole team can work this way, not just me. (Exit. The team keeps shipping.)
